data.value: Before the October 1 deadline, will the editor-in-chief of the Daily Chronicle, after consulting with the publisher, decide to retract the article about the mayor's alleged corruption?

The Daily Chronicle published an article alleging corruption by the mayor. There is public and internal pressure regarding the article's accuracy. The Editor-in-Chief intends to consult the publisher before deciding on retraction. The deadline for a decision is October 1.
